verdict.rationale: First-party docs show partitioning into structured elements with metadata in consistent JSON (unstructured-docs-32/60). Chunking rearranges those elements to fit embedding-model limits and improve retrieval precision, with by-title, by-page and by-similarity strategies that give semantic boundaries (unstructured-docs-33/11/25). Jobs, the SDK, the REST API and the MCP server output partitioned, chunked and embedded JSON with vectors (unstructured-docs-35/22/23/30). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality and boundary behavior in practice.
